decisions.reason: The words of 1 Corinthians 12:10 ("능력 있는 일") and plain Korean for "sign" and "wonder".

decisions.choice: "이루어졌습니다" (L); "행해졌습니다" (B); "일어났습니다" (R), passive with no named doer
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the passive as God's work through Paul, which lets him avoid saying "I did".

decisions.choice: "인내" (L, B); "참고 꿋꿋이 견디다" (R)
decisions.reason: The endurance of 1:6 and 6:4.

source.text: τί γάρ ἐστιν ὃ ἡσσώθητε ὑπὲρ τὰς λοιπὰς ἐκκλησίας, εἰ μὴ ὅτι αὐτὸς ἐγὼ οὐ κατενάρκησα ὑμῶν;

records.literal_gloss: What for is it which you were made inferior beyond the rest churches, except that myself I not burdened you?

en.L: For in what were you treated worse than the rest of the churches, except that I myself did not burden you?
en.B: In what way were you put at a disadvantage compared with the other churches, except that I myself never lived off you?
en.R: The only way I treated you worse than the other churches was this: I did not ask you to support me.

fr.L: En quoi, en effet, avez-vous été traités moins bien que les autres églises, sinon en ce que moi-même je ne vous ai pas été à charge ?
fr.B: En quoi avez-vous été désavantagés par rapport aux autres églises, sinon en ce que moi, je n’ai jamais vécu à vos dépens ?
fr.R: Je vous ai traités moins bien que les autres églises sur un seul point : je ne vous ai pas demandé de m’entretenir.

es.L: Porque ¿en qué {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} tratados peor que las demás iglesias, sino en que yo mismo no {{plural_you:les|os}} fui una carga?
es.B: ¿En qué {{plural_you:quedaron|quedasteis}} en desventaja respecto a las otras iglesias, sino en que yo mismo nunca viví a costa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.R: La única manera en que {{plural_you:los|os}} traté peor que a las otras iglesias fue esta: no {{plural_you:les|os}} pedí que me {{plural_you:mantuvieran|mantuvierais}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana ni katika nini mlitendewa vibaya kuliko makanisa mengine, isipokuwa kwamba mimi mwenyewe sikuwalemea?
sw.B: Mlipunjwa kwa namna gani ukilinganisha na makanisa mengine, isipokuwa kwamba mimi mwenyewe sikuwahi kuishi kwa gharama yenu?
sw.R: Njia pekee niliyowatendea vibaya kuliko makanisa mengine ni hii: sikuwaomba mnitegemeze.

vi.L: Vì có điều gì mà anh chị em bị đối xử kém hơn các Hội Thánh khác, ngoại trừ việc chính tôi đã không làm gánh nặng cho anh chị em?
vi.B: Anh chị em đã chịu thiệt thòi gì so với các Hội Thánh khác, ngoại trừ việc chính tôi chưa bao giờ sống nhờ anh chị em?
vi.R: Điều duy nhất tôi đối xử với anh chị em kém hơn các Hội Thánh khác là thế này: tôi đã không xin anh chị em nuôi tôi.

ko.L: 내가 여러분에게 짐을 지우지 않은 것 외에, 여러분이 다른 교회들보다 못한 대우를 받은 것이 무엇입니까?
ko.B: 내가 여러분에게 얹혀살지 않은 것 말고, 여러분이 다른 교회들보다 손해를 본 것이 무엇입니까?
ko.R: 내가 다른 교회들보다 여러분을 못하게 대한 것은 이것 하나뿐입니다. 나는 여러분에게 나를 도와 달라고 하지 않았습니다.

decisions.choice: burden: be a financial burden, live at their expense
decisions.reason: κατενάρκησα is to weigh on someone, here by taking support. Paul used the same verb in 11:9: in Corinth he took nothing from them and was supported by believers from Macedonia (compare 1 Corinthians 9:12-18).

decisions.choice: you were treated worse: made to come off worse than other churches
decisions.reason: ἡσσώθητε means to be made inferior, to lose out. The rivals seem to have argued that Paul's refusal of support showed he did not love the Corinthians, or that he was no real apostle (11:7-11).

decisions.choice: an ironic question
decisions.reason: The question answers itself: the only "disadvantage" the Corinthians suffered was that Paul cost them nothing.

decisions.choice: lived off you (B); ask you to support me (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what kind of burden Paul means (m1).

decisions.choice: les autres églises, lowercase
decisions.reason: The word means the local congregations, so French writes "église" with a small letter, as the style guide sets for one congregation.

decisions.choice: "làm gánh nặng cho" (L); "sống nhờ" (B); "xin ... nuôi tôi" (R) for katanarkao
decisions.reason: A financial burden (m1); the Literal form of 11:9.

decisions.choice: "짐을 지우다" (L), as at 11:9; "얹혀살다" (B); "도와 달라고 하다" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the verb as being a financial burden.

source.text: χαρίσασθέ μοι τὴν ἀδικίαν ταύτην.

records.literal_gloss: Forgive me the wrong this.

en.L: Forgive me this wrong.
en.B: Please forgive me for this injustice!
en.R: Please forgive me for being so unfair to you!

fr.L: Pardonnez-moi cette injustice.
fr.B: Pardonnez-moi donc cette injustice !
fr.R: Pardonnez-moi, s’il vous plaît, d’avoir été si injuste envers vous !

es.L: {{plural_you:Perdónenme|Perdonadme}} esta injusticia.
es.B: ¡Por favor, {{plural_you:perdónenme|perdonadme}} esta injusticia!
es.R: ¡Por favor, {{plural_you:perdónenme|perdonadme}} por haber sido tan injusto con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}!

sw.L: Nisameheni kosa hili.
sw.B: Tafadhali nisameheni kwa udhalimu huu!
sw.R: Tafadhali nisameheni kwa kuwaonea hivyo!

vi.L: Xin hãy tha cho tôi điều sai trái này.
vi.B: Xin hãy tha thứ cho tôi sự bất công này!
vi.R: Xin hãy tha thứ cho tôi vì đã đối xử bất công với anh chị em như vậy!

ko.L: 이 불의를 용서해 주십시오.
ko.B: 이 불공평한 일을 부디 용서해 주십시오!
ko.R: 여러분을 이렇게 불공평하게 대한 것을 부디 용서해 주십시오!

decisions.choice: forgive me this wrong: biting irony
decisions.reason: Paul calls his refusal of their money a ἀδικίαν ("wrong, injustice") only in irony: the "wrong" was that he served them for free.

decisions.choice: forgive: pardon as a favor
decisions.reason: χαρίσασθέ comes from the same root as grace and means to give freely, here to forgive, as in 2:7, 10.

decisions.choice: an exclamation mark
decisions.reason: The exclamation lets the irony be heard (m1).

decisions.choice: "tha cho tôi" (L); "tha thứ cho tôi" (B, R) for charizomai
decisions.reason: Biting irony (m1); to pardon as a favor (m2).

decisions.choice: "불의" (L); "불공평한 일" (B); "불공평하게 대한 것" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as biting irony; Literal keeps the strong word.

source.text: Ἰδοὺ τρίτον τοῦτο ἑτοίμως ἔχω ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, καὶ οὐ καταναρκήσω· οὐ γὰρ ζητῶ τὰ ὑμῶν ἀλλὰ ὑμᾶς, οὐ γὰρ ὀφείλει τὰ τέκνα τοῖς γονεῦσιν θησαυρίζειν, ἀλλὰ οἱ γονεῖς τοῖς τέκνοις.

records.literal_gloss: Look, third [time] this I am ready to come to you, and not I will be a burden; not for I seek the [things] of you but you, not for ought the children for the parents to store up, but the parents for the children.

en.L: Look, this [is the] third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden; for I do not seek what is yours but you; for the children ought not to store up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
en.B: Here I am, ready to come to you for the third time, and I will not live off you. I am not after your money; I am after you. It is not for children to put money aside for their parents; it is parents who put it aside for their children.
en.R: This will be the third time I visit you, and I am ready to come. I will not ask you to support me. I do not want your money. I want you. It is not the children's job to save money for their parents. Parents save money for their children.

fr.L: Voici, [pour] la troisième fois, je suis prêt à venir chez vous, et je ne vous serai pas à charge ; car je ne cherche pas ce qui est à vous, mais vous ; car les enfants ne doivent pas amasser pour les parents, mais les parents pour les enfants.
fr.B: Me voici prêt à venir chez vous pour la troisième fois, et je ne vivrai pas à vos dépens. Ce n’est pas votre argent que je cherche, c’est vous. Ce n’est pas aux enfants de mettre de l’argent de côté pour leurs parents ; ce sont les parents qui en mettent de côté pour leurs enfants.
fr.R: Ce sera la troisième fois que je viens vous voir, et je suis prêt à venir. Je ne vous demanderai pas de m’entretenir. Je ne veux pas votre argent. C’est vous que je veux. Ce n’est pas aux enfants d’économiser de l’argent pour leurs parents. Ce sont les parents qui économisent pour leurs enfants.

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, esta [es la] tercera vez que estoy preparado para ir a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y no seré una carga; porque no busco lo {{plural_you:de ustedes|vuestro}}, sino a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; porque no deben los hijos atesorar para los padres, sino los padres para los hijos.
es.B: Aquí estoy, preparado para ir a {{plural_you:verlos|veros}} por tercera vez, y no viviré a costa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. No busco {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} dinero; {{plural_you:los|os}} busco a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. No les corresponde a los hijos ahorrar para los padres, sino a los padres ahorrar para los hijos.
es.R: Esta será la tercera vez que {{plural_you:los|os}} visite, y estoy listo para ir. No {{plural_you:les|os}} pediré que me {{plural_you:mantengan|mantengáis}}. No quiero {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} dinero. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} quiero a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. No es tarea de los hijos ahorrar dinero para sus padres. Son los padres los que ahorran dinero para sus hijos.

sw.L: Tazama, hii ni mara ya tatu niko tayari kuja kwenu, wala sitawalemea; kwa maana sitafuti vitu vyenu bali ninyi; kwa maana watoto hawapaswi kuwawekea wazazi akiba, bali wazazi kwa watoto.
sw.B: Sasa niko tayari kuja kwenu kwa mara ya tatu, wala sitaishi kwa gharama yenu. Sitafuti fedha zenu; nawatafuta ninyi. Si kazi ya watoto kuwawekea wazazi wao akiba; ni wazazi wanaowawekea watoto wao.
sw.R: Hii itakuwa mara ya tatu kuwatembelea, nami niko tayari kuja. Sitawaomba mnitegemeze. Sitaki fedha zenu. Nawataka ninyi. Si kazi ya watoto kuwawekea wazazi wao akiba ya fedha. Wazazi ndio huwawekea watoto wao.

vi.L: Kìa, đây là lần thứ ba tôi sẵn sàng đến với anh chị em, và tôi sẽ không làm gánh nặng; vì tôi không tìm của cải anh chị em, nhưng tìm chính anh chị em; vì con cái không phải để dành cho cha mẹ, nhưng cha mẹ để dành cho con cái.
vi.B: Này, tôi sẵn sàng đến với anh chị em lần thứ ba, và tôi sẽ không sống nhờ anh chị em. Tôi không tìm tiền bạc của anh chị em; tôi tìm chính anh chị em. Con cái không có bổn phận để dành tiền cho cha mẹ; chính cha mẹ mới để dành cho con cái.
vi.R: Đây sẽ là lần thứ ba tôi đến thăm anh chị em, và tôi đã sẵn sàng đến. Tôi sẽ không xin anh chị em nuôi tôi. Tôi không muốn tiền của anh chị em. Tôi muốn chính anh chị em. Con cái không có bổn phận để dành tiền cho cha mẹ. Cha mẹ mới là người để dành tiền cho con cái.

ko.L: 보십시오, 나는 세 번째로 여러분에게 갈 준비가 되어 있습니다. 나는 여러분에게 짐이 되지 않을 것입니다. 나는 여러분의 것을 구하는 것이 아니라 여러분을 구하기 때문입니다. 자녀가 부모를 위해 재물을 모아 두는 것이 아니라, 부모가 자녀를 위해 모아 두는 것입니다.
ko.B: 이제 나는 세 번째로 여러분에게 갈 준비가 되어 있습니다. 그리고 나는 여러분에게 얹혀살지 않을 것입니다. 내가 바라는 것은 여러분의 돈이 아니라 여러분입니다. 자녀가 부모를 위해 돈을 모아 두는 것이 아니라, 부모가 자녀를 위해 돈을 모아 두는 것입니다.
ko.R: 이번이 내가 여러분을 세 번째로 찾아가는 것인데, 나는 갈 준비가 되어 있습니다. 나는 여러분에게 나를 도와 달라고 하지 않을 것입니다. 나는 여러분의 돈을 원하지 않습니다. 나는 여러분을 원합니다. 자녀가 부모를 위해 돈을 모으는 것이 아닙니다. 부모가 자녀를 위해 돈을 모읍니다.

decisions.choice: the third time: Paul's third visit to Corinth
alternatives: the third time he has got ready, without coming
decisions.reason: τρίτον τοῦτο could mean that this is the third time Paul has been ready to come. But 13:1 says plainly "this is the third time I am coming to you", so a third visit is meant: the first when he founded the church (Acts 18), the second the painful visit (2:1), and now a third.

decisions.choice: not what is yours but you: not their money but themselves
alternatives: not their praise but their obedience
decisions.reason: τὰ ὑμῶν ("the things of you") are their possessions. Paul wants the Corinthians themselves, their faith and love, as 12:15 goes on to say.

decisions.choice: parents save up for their children: Paul speaks as their father
alternatives: a general rule about inheritance law
decisions.reason: It was the normal duty of parents to provide for their children, not the other way round. Paul calls himself the Corinthians' father in the faith (1 Corinthians 4:14-15; 2 Corinthians 6:13), so he will not take from them.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "I will not be a burden", with no "to you"
alternatives: "I will not be a burden to you"
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts add "to you". The meaning is the same. The SBLGNT text is followed. Reviewers must check the manuscript evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: live off you; your money (B); ask you to support me; your money (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say outright that the burden and the possessions are money (m2), as in verse 13.

decisions.choice: être à charge (L); vivre à vos dépens (B); demander de m’entretenir (R), as in verse 13
decisions.reason: "Être à charge" is the French expression for being a financial burden on someone, which is the sense here (m1 in verse 13); Balanced and Readable say it more plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "cha mẹ", "con cái"
decisions.reason: Paul speaks as their father (m3), but only by the proverb; "anh chị em" stays the pronoun, as in 1 Corinthians 4:14-15.

decisions.choice: "của cải anh chị em" (L); "tiền bạc của anh chị em" (B); "tiền của anh chị em" (R)
alternatives: "những gì thuộc về anh chị em"
decisions.reason: Not their money but themselves (m2).

decisions.choice: "세 번째로 여러분에게 갈" (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase as Paul's third visit.

source.text: ἐγὼ δὲ ἥδιστα δαπανήσω καὶ ἐκδαπανηθήσομαι ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: I but most gladly will spend and will be spent out on behalf of the souls of you.

en.L: And I will most gladly spend and be utterly spent for your souls.
en.B: For my part, I will gladly spend everything I have, and spend myself to the last, for your sake.
en.R: I am very happy to spend everything I have for you, and even to use up my whole life for you.

fr.L: Et moi, très volontiers je dépenserai et je serai entièrement dépensé pour vos âmes.
fr.B: Pour ma part, je dépenserai volontiers tout ce que j’ai, et je me dépenserai moi-même jusqu’au bout, pour vous.
fr.R: Je suis très heureux de dépenser tout ce que j’ai pour vous, et même de donner toute ma vie pour vous.

es.L: Y yo con muchísimo gusto gastaré y me desgastaré del todo por {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} almas.
es.B: Por mi parte, con gusto gastaré todo lo que tengo, y me desgastaré hasta el final, por el bien de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Me alegra mucho gastar todo lo que tengo por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y hasta gastar mi vida entera por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

sw.L: Nami kwa furaha kubwa nitatumia na kutumiwa kabisa kwa ajili ya nafsi zenu.
sw.B: Kwa upande wangu, nitafurahi kutumia kila nilicho nacho, na kujitumia mwenyewe mpaka mwisho, kwa ajili yenu.
sw.R: Ninafurahi sana kutumia kila kitu nilicho nacho kwa ajili yenu, hata kutumia maisha yangu yote kwa ajili yenu.

vi.L: Còn tôi, tôi sẽ rất vui lòng chi dùng và bị chi dùng hết vì linh hồn anh chị em.
vi.B: Về phần tôi, tôi sẽ vui lòng tiêu hết mọi thứ tôi có, và hao mòn chính mình đến cùng vì anh chị em.
vi.R: Tôi rất vui được dùng hết mọi thứ tôi có cho anh chị em, và thậm chí dùng hết cả cuộc đời mình vì anh chị em.

ko.L: 나는 여러분의 영혼을 위해 매우 기쁘게 [내 것을] 쓰고, 나 자신까지도 다 쓰겠습니다.
ko.B: 나로서는 여러분을 위해 내가 가진 모든 것을 기꺼이 쓰고, 나 자신까지도 마지막까지 다 쓰겠습니다.
ko.R: 나는 여러분을 위해 내가 가진 모든 것을 기쁘게 쓰고, 내 온 삶까지도 여러분을 위해 다 쓰겠습니다.

decisions.choice: spend and be utterly spent: give his means and himself
decisions.reason: δαπανήσω is to spend money or resources; ἐκδαπανηθήσομαι is the passive of a stronger form, to be used up completely. The step from the one to the other moves from what Paul has to what he is.

decisions.choice: your souls: you yourselves, your lives
alternatives: the soul as opposed to the body
decisions.reason: ψυχῶν here means the whole person and life, as often in Paul (1 Thessalonians 2:8). Paul spends himself for their good as persons.

decisions.choice: for your sake (B); for you (R)
decisions.reason: "Souls" in English can suggest the inner part only; Balanced and Readable say "for you" (m2).

decisions.choice: nafsi zenu
decisions.reason: "Nafsi" is the self, the person, which is the sense here (meaning decision); "roho" would be heard as the spirit apart from the body.

decisions.choice: "chi dùng và bị chi dùng hết vì linh hồn anh chị em" (L); "tiêu hết ... hao mòn chính mình ... vì anh chị em" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Giving his means and himself (m1); "your souls" means you yourselves (m2), so Literal keeps "linh hồn" and the other levels say "anh chị em".

decisions.choice: "쓰다 ... 나 자신까지도 다 쓰다" (L)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the pair as giving his means and then himself.

decisions.choice: "영혼" (L); "여러분" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as the whole person; Literal keeps the noun, and the English Basic and Readable say "you".

source.text: εἰ περισσοτέρως ὑμᾶς ἀγαπῶν, ἧσσον ἀγαπῶμαι;

records.literal_gloss: If more abundantly you loving, less am I loved?

en.L: If, loving you all the more, I am loved less?
en.B: If I love you so much more, does that mean you love me less?
en.R: I love you more and more. Should that make you love me less?

fr.L: Si, vous aimant davantage, je suis moins aimé ?
fr.B: Si je vous aime tellement plus, faut-il que vous m’aimiez moins ?
fr.R: Je vous aime de plus en plus. Est-ce une raison pour que vous m’aimiez moins ?

es.L: ¿Si, {{plural_you:amándolos|amándoos}} más, soy amado menos?
es.B: Si yo {{plural_you:los|os}} amo mucho más, ¿quiere decir eso que {{plural_you:me aman|me amáis}} menos?
es.R: Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} amo cada vez más. ¿Por eso {{plural_you:me van a amar|me vais a amar}} menos?

sw.L: Ikiwa, nikiwapenda ninyi zaidi sana, napendwa kidogo?
sw.B: Ikiwa nawapenda zaidi hivi, je, ina maana kwamba ninyi mnanipenda kidogo?
sw.R: Ninawapenda zaidi na zaidi. Je, hilo liwafanye mnipende kidogo?

vi.L: Nếu tôi càng yêu thương anh chị em nhiều hơn, thì tôi lại được yêu thương ít hơn sao?
vi.B: Nếu tôi yêu thương anh chị em nhiều hơn biết bao, thì có phải anh chị em lại yêu thương tôi ít hơn không?
vi.R: Tôi ngày càng yêu thương anh chị em hơn. Điều đó có làm cho anh chị em yêu thương tôi ít đi không?

ko.L: 내가 여러분을 더욱 사랑하는데, 내가 덜 사랑을 받아야 합니까?
ko.B: 내가 여러분을 훨씬 더 사랑하는데, 그렇다고 여러분은 나를 덜 사랑하겠습니까?
ko.R: 나는 여러분을 점점 더 사랑합니다. 그렇다고 여러분이 나를 덜 사랑해야 하겠습니까?

decisions.choice: a question: should more love from Paul mean less love from them?
alternatives: a statement: though I love you more, I am loved less
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT punctuates the sentence as a question, which makes it a rebuke. Read as a statement it is a lament. Either way Paul's love is met with less love in return, so the meaning is close.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "if" with the participle "loving"
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts read "even if" and a finite verb, "even if I love you more". The meaning is the same. The SBLGNT text is followed. Reviewers must check the manuscript evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: A question at every level
decisions.reason: Follows the SBLGNT punctuation, which the meaning decision reads as a rebuke.

source.text: ἔστω δέ, ἐγὼ οὐ κατεβάρησα ὑμᾶς· ἀλλὰ ὑπάρχων πανοῦργος δόλῳ ὑμᾶς ἔλαβον.

records.literal_gloss: Let it be but, I not burdened you; but being crafty by deceit you I took.

en.L: But let it be so: I did not burden you. "But, being crafty, I took you by deceit."
en.B: Granted, I myself did not weigh you down. Still, some say I was cunning and caught you with a trick.
en.R: Some of you agree that I did not make you pay for me. But they say I was sly and tricked you.

fr.L: Mais soit : moi, je n’ai pas pesé sur vous. « Mais, étant astucieux, je vous ai pris par ruse. »
fr.B: Soit, je n’ai pas été un poids pour vous. Pourtant, certains disent que j’ai été habile et que je vous ai pris au piège par une ruse.
fr.R: Certains d’entre vous reconnaissent que je ne vous ai pas fait payer pour moi. Mais ils disent que j’ai été malin et que je vous ai trompés.

es.L: Pero sea así: yo no {{plural_you:les|os}} fui una carga. «Pero, siendo astuto, {{plural_you:los|os}} atrapé con engaño».
es.B: Concedido: yo mismo no {{plural_you:les|os}} fui una carga. Aun así, algunos dicen que fui astuto y que {{plural_you:los|os}} atrapé con un engaño.
es.R: Algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} reconocen que no {{plural_you:les|os}} hice pagar mis gastos. Pero dicen que fui astuto y que {{plural_you:los|os}} engañé.

sw.L: Lakini na iwe hivyo: mimi sikuwalemea. "Lakini, kwa kuwa nilikuwa mjanja, niliwanasa kwa hila."
sw.B: Sawa, mimi mwenyewe sikuwalemea. Hata hivyo, wengine wanasema kwamba nilikuwa mjanja, nikawanasa kwa hila.
sw.R: Baadhi yenu mnakubali kwamba sikuwafanya mnilipie. Lakini wanasema nilikuwa mjanja, nikawadanganya.

vi.L: Nhưng cứ cho là vậy: tôi đã không làm gánh nặng cho anh chị em. "Nhưng vì xảo quyệt, tôi đã dùng mưu kế bắt lấy anh chị em."
vi.B: Cứ cho là chính tôi đã không đè nặng trên anh chị em. Thế nhưng có người nói rằng tôi xảo quyệt và đã dùng mưu kế bắt lấy anh chị em.
vi.R: Một số người trong anh chị em đồng ý rằng tôi đã không bắt anh chị em phải trả tiền cho tôi. Nhưng họ nói rằng tôi khôn lanh và đã lừa anh chị em.

ko.L: 그렇다고 합시다. 나는 여러분에게 짐을 지우지 않았습니다. "그러나 간교한 사람이어서 속임수로 여러분을 사로잡았다."
ko.B: 좋습니다. 나 자신은 여러분에게 짐이 되지 않았습니다. 그런데도 어떤 사람들은 내가 교활해서 속임수로 여러분을 낚았다고 말합니다.
ko.R: 여러분 가운데 어떤 사람들은 내가 여러분에게 돈을 내게 하지 않았다는 것을 인정합니다. 그러나 그들은 내가 교활해서 여러분을 속였다고 말합니다.

decisions.choice: the second half voices a charge made against Paul
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT has no quotation marks, but ἀλλὰ ὑπάρχων πανοῦργος δόλῳ ὑμᾶς ἔλαβον ("but being crafty, I took you by deceit") is not something Paul admits. He repeats what some were saying, in his own voice and with irony: that he took no support openly but got their money in a cunning way. Verses 17-18 answer exactly that charge. Who made it, the rivals or some in the church, is not said.

decisions.choice: crafty, by deceit: cunning trickery for gain
decisions.reason: πανοῦργος is a cunning, unscrupulous person, and δόλῳ is deceit or a trap; ὑμᾶς ἔλαβον is to catch someone, like prey. The charge seems to be that the collection for Jerusalem (chapters 8-9) was a way to get money from them through others (verses 17-18).

decisions.choice: let it be so: granted
decisions.reason: ἔστω δέ grants a point for argument: "all right, granted". It is the Corinthians' admission that Paul himself took nothing.

decisions.choice: quotation marks
decisions.reason: Literal marks the charge with quotation marks, as other quoted sayings in these letters are marked (m1).

decisions.choice: some say (B); Some of you agree ... But they say (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say outright that this is what others claim (m1). Readable also makes the admission in the first half theirs (m3).

decisions.choice: weigh you down
decisions.reason: This verb differs from the one in verses 13-14, so Balanced uses a different phrase for it.

decisions.choice: je n’ai pas pesé sur vous (L); je n’ai pas été un poids pour vous (B)
alternatives: je ne vous ai pas été à charge
decisions.reason: This verb differs from the one in verses 13-14, so French keeps "être à charge" for that one and uses the picture of weight here, as the English "weigh you down" does.

decisions.choice: the charge in quotation marks (L); "có người nói rằng" (B); "họ nói rằng" (R)
decisions.reason: The second half voices a charge made against Paul (m1), as the English marks it.

decisions.choice: "xảo quyệt ... mưu kế" (L, B); "khôn lanh ... lừa" (R) for panourgos and dolos
decisions.reason: Cunning trickery for gain (m2); "xảo quyệt" is the word of 11:3.

decisions.choice: Literal quotes the charge in the plain style ("사로잡았다"), as the English Literal does
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the second half as a charge made against Paul.

decisions.choice: "간교한 ... 속임수로" (L); "교활해서 ... 속임수로" (B); "교활해서 ... 속였다" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the words as cunning trickery for gain.

source.text: μή τινα ὧν ἀπέσταλκα πρὸς ὑμᾶς, δι’ αὐτοῦ ἐπλεονέκτησα ὑμᾶς;

records.literal_gloss: Not anyone of whom I have sent to you, through him did I take advantage of you?

en.L: Any of those whom I have sent to you, did I exploit you through him?
en.B: Take any one of those I have sent to you: did I use any of them to cheat you?
en.R: I sent some people to you. Did I use any of them to cheat you? No!

fr.L: Quelqu’un de ceux que je vous ai envoyés, est-ce par lui que je vous ai exploités ?
fr.B: Prenez n’importe lequel de ceux que je vous ai envoyés : me suis-je servi de l’un d’eux pour profiter de vous ?
fr.R: Je vous ai envoyé des gens. Est-ce que je me suis servi de l’un d’eux pour profiter de vous ? Non !

es.L: De los que he enviado a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, ¿acaso por medio de alguno de ellos me aproveché de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.B: {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} en cualquiera de los que {{plural_you:les|os}} he enviado: ¿usé a alguno de ellos para {{plural_you:estafarlos|estafaros}}?
es.R: Yo {{plural_you:les|os}} envié a algunas personas. ¿Usé a alguna de ellas para {{plural_you:estafarlos|estafaros}}? ¡No!

sw.L: Je, yeyote kati ya wale niliowatuma kwenu, je, niliwanyonya kupitia yeye?
sw.B: Chukueni yeyote kati ya wale niliowatuma kwenu: je, nilimtumia yeyote wao kuwapunja?
sw.R: Niliwatuma watu fulani kwenu. Je, nilimtumia yeyote wao kuwapunja? Hapana!

vi.L: Trong những người tôi đã sai đến với anh chị em, có ai mà qua người ấy tôi đã bóc lột anh chị em không?
vi.B: Hãy xem bất cứ ai trong những người tôi đã sai đến với anh chị em: tôi có dùng ai trong họ để lợi dụng anh chị em không?
vi.R: Tôi đã sai một số người đến với anh chị em. Tôi có dùng ai trong họ để lợi dụng anh chị em không? Không!

ko.L: 내가 여러분에게 보낸 사람들 가운데 누구를 통해서 여러분에게서 이득을 취했습니까?
ko.B: 내가 여러분에게 보낸 사람들 가운데 누구를 생각해 보십시오. 내가 그들 가운데 누구를 이용해서 여러분을 속여 빼앗았습니까?
ko.R: 나는 몇 사람을 여러분에게 보냈습니다. 내가 그들 가운데 누구를 이용해서 여러분을 속였습니까? 아닙니다!

decisions.choice: a question expecting "no", with a broken construction
decisions.reason: μή marks a question that expects the answer "no". The sentence starts with "any of those I have sent" and then restarts with "through him".

decisions.choice: exploit: take advantage of someone for gain
decisions.reason: ἐπλεονέκτησα is to take more than one's share, to cheat for gain. Paul uses it in 7:2, where he says he has cheated no one.

decisions.choice: exploit (L); cheat (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same words as in 7:2.

decisions.choice: No!
decisions.reason: Readable gives the answer the Greek question expects (m1).

decisions.choice: exploiter (L); profiter de vous (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means taking advantage of someone for gain (m2). "Profiter de quelqu’un" says that in everyday French; "escroquer" would claim an outright fraud. The same words serve for Titus in verse 18.

decisions.choice: aprovecharse de (L); estafar (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to take unfair advantage, here of money (meaning decision). Literal keeps the general "aprovecharse de"; Balanced and Readable name the charge plainly, as the English says "cheat".

decisions.choice: kunyonya (L); kupunja (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal uses "kunyonya" (to exploit), the word for this verb in 7:2; Balanced and Readable say "kupunja" (to cheat someone of what is theirs), as the English says "cheat". The same words return in verse 18.

decisions.choice: "bóc lột" (L); "lợi dụng" (B, R) for pleonekteo
decisions.reason: Taking advantage of someone for gain (m2); as in 2:11 and 7:2.

decisions.choice: "이득을 취하다" (L); "속여 빼앗다" (B); "속이다" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of 7:2.

decisions.choice: Literal smooths the broken construction into one question
decisions.reason: Korean cannot hold the Greek's change of construction; the meaning is unchanged.

source.text: παρεκάλεσα Τίτον καὶ συναπέστειλα τὸν ἀδελφόν· μήτι ἐπλεονέκτησεν ὑμᾶς Τίτος;

records.literal_gloss: I urged Titus and I sent with [him] the brother; not did take advantage of you Titus?

en.L: I urged Titus [to go], and I sent the brother with [him]. Titus did not exploit you, did he?
en.B: I urged Titus to go, and I sent the brother with him. Titus did not cheat you, did he?
en.R: I asked Titus to visit you, and I sent the other brother with him. Titus did not cheat you, did he?

fr.L: J’ai exhorté Tite [à aller], et j’ai envoyé le frère avec [lui]. Tite ne vous a pas exploités, n’est-ce pas ?
fr.B: J’ai insisté auprès de Tite pour qu’il aille chez vous, et j’ai envoyé le frère avec lui. Tite n’a pas profité de vous, n’est-ce pas ?
fr.R: J’ai demandé à Tite d’aller vous voir, et j’ai envoyé l’autre frère avec lui. Tite n’a pas profité de vous, n’est-ce pas ?

es.L: Exhorté a Tito [a ir], y envié con [él] al hermano. ¿Acaso Tito se aprovechó de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.B: Le pedí a Tito que fuera, y envié con él al hermano. Tito no {{plural_you:los|os}} estafó, ¿verdad?
es.R: Le pedí a Tito que fuera a {{plural_you:visitarlos|visitaros}}, y envié con él al otro hermano. Tito no {{plural_you:los|os}} estafó, ¿verdad?

sw.L: Nilimsihi Tito [aende], nami nikamtuma ndugu pamoja [naye]. Tito hakuwanyonya, au sivyo?
sw.B: Nilimsihi Tito aende, nami nikamtuma ndugu yule pamoja naye. Tito hakuwapunja, sivyo?
sw.R: Nilimwomba Tito awatembelee, nikamtuma yule ndugu mwingine pamoja naye. Tito hakuwapunja, sivyo?

vi.L: Tôi đã khuyên Tít [đi], và đã sai người anh em đi cùng với [anh ấy]. Tít đã không bóc lột anh chị em, phải không?
vi.B: Tôi đã khuyên Tít đi, và đã sai người anh em đi cùng với anh ấy. Tít đâu có lợi dụng anh chị em, phải không?
vi.R: Tôi đã xin Tít đến thăm anh chị em, và đã sai người anh em kia đi cùng với anh ấy. Tít đâu có lợi dụng anh chị em, phải không?

ko.L: 나는 디도에게 [가라고] 권했고, 그와 함께 그 형제를 보냈습니다. 디도가 여러분에게서 이득을 취했습니까?
ko.B: 나는 디도에게 가라고 권했고, 그와 함께 그 형제를 보냈습니다. 디도가 여러분을 속여 빼앗았습니까? 그렇지 않습니다.
ko.R: 나는 디도에게 여러분을 찾아가 달라고 부탁했고, 다른 형제 한 사람을 그와 함께 보냈습니다. 디도가 여러분을 속였습니까? 그렇지 않습니다.

decisions.choice: an earlier visit by Titus, with a brother
decisions.reason: The verbs are aorist and Paul appeals to how Titus behaved, so the visit had already happened. It is most likely the visit when Titus began the collection (8:6). Some read it as the sending described in 8:16-24, written from the readers' point of view, but there Titus goes with two brothers, not one.

decisions.choice: the brother: a believer the Corinthians knew, one particular man
decisions.reason: τὸν ἀδελφόν is a fellow believer, known to the readers and not named here. He is one particular man.

decisions.choice: a question expecting "no"
decisions.reason: μήτι marks a question that expects the answer "no".

decisions.choice: the brother, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: He is one particular man (m2), so no gender setting applies, as in 8:18.

decisions.choice: Titus did not ..., did he?
decisions.reason: A tag question shows that the expected answer is "no" (m3).

decisions.choice: "người anh em" with no gender span
decisions.reason: One particular man (m2), as in 8:18-22.

decisions.choice: "..., phải không?"
decisions.reason: A question expecting "no" (m3); the tag question gives the same answer.

decisions.choice: "그 형제" at every level, with no gender span
decisions.reason: One particular man known to the readers.

decisions.choice: "...습니까? 그렇지 않습니다." (B, R) for the question expecting "no"
decisions.reason: Korean has no tag question; Basic and Readable add the answer, and Literal leaves the question bare.

source.text: οὐ τῷ αὐτῷ πνεύματι περιεπατήσαμεν;

records.literal_gloss: Not in the same spirit did we walk?

en.L: Did we not walk in the same spirit?
en.B: Did we not conduct ourselves in the same spirit?
en.R: He and I always acted in the same way, did we not?

fr.L: N’avons-nous pas marché dans le même esprit ?
fr.B: N’avons-nous pas agi dans le même esprit ?
fr.R: Lui et moi, nous avons toujours agi de la même façon, n’est-ce pas ?

es.L: ¿No anduvimos en el mismo espíritu?
es.B: ¿No nos comportamos con el mismo espíritu?
es.R: Él y yo siempre actuamos de la misma manera, ¿no es así?

sw.L: Je, hatukuenenda katika roho ile ile?
sw.B: Je, hatukujiendesha kwa roho ile ile?
sw.R: Yeye nami siku zote tulitenda kwa namna ile ile, sivyo?

vi.L: Chẳng phải chúng tôi đã bước đi trong cùng một tinh thần sao?
vi.B: Chẳng phải chúng tôi đã cư xử với cùng một tinh thần sao?
vi.R: Anh ấy và tôi luôn hành động như nhau, phải không?

ko.L: 우리가 같은 영으로 행하지 않았습니까?
ko.B: 우리가 같은 마음으로 행동하지 않았습니까?
ko.R: 디도와 나는 언제나 같은 방식으로 행동했습니다. 그렇지 않습니까?

decisions.choice: the same spirit: the same attitude and way of acting
decisions.reason: τῷ αὐτῷ πνεύματι may mean the Holy Spirit, who led Paul and Titus alike, or the same spirit in the sense of attitude. The parallel question "in the same footsteps?" points to the manner of their conduct, so a small letter is used; but Paul often speaks of walking by the Spirit (Galatians 5:16, 25), and both may be in view.

decisions.choice: walk: live, conduct oneself
decisions.reason: περιεπατήσαμεν ("we walked") is Paul's usual picture for a way of life.

decisions.choice: we: Paul and Titus
decisions.reason: The "we" here joins Paul with Titus.

decisions.choice: spirit, with a small letter
decisions.reason: A small letter follows the reading in m1, which is uncertain.

decisions.choice: roho ile ile (lowercase)
decisions.reason: Here the word is an attitude and way of acting (meaning decision), so Swahili writes "roho" lowercase with "ile ile" (class 9 agreement), unlike "Roho yule yule" for the Holy Spirit in 4:13.

decisions.choice: "cùng một tinh thần" (L, B), with "bước đi" (L) and "cư xử" (B)
decisions.reason: The same attitude and way of acting (m1, uncertain), with a small letter in the English; "tinh thần" is the human attitude.

decisions.choice: "영" (L); "마음" (B); "같은 방식" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves open whether this is the Holy Spirit or the same attitude; the English has "spirit" with a small letter, so Korean does not write "성령".

decisions.choice: "행하다" (L), the project's word for "walk" as a way of life
decisions.reason: As at 10:2.

source.text: οὐ τοῖς αὐτοῖς ἴχνεσιν;

records.literal_gloss: Not in the same footsteps?

en.L: Not in the same footsteps?
en.B: Did we not tread in the same footsteps?
en.R: We did things the same way, did we not?

fr.L: Pas sur les mêmes traces ?
fr.B: N’avons-nous pas marché sur les mêmes traces ?
fr.R: Nous avons fait les choses de la même manière, n’est-ce pas ?

es.L: ¿No en las mismas pisadas?
es.B: ¿No seguimos las mismas pisadas?
es.R: Hicimos las cosas de la misma manera, ¿no es cierto?

sw.L: Si katika nyayo zile zile?
sw.B: Je, hatukufuata nyayo zile zile?
sw.R: Tulifanya mambo kwa njia ile ile, sivyo?

vi.L: Chẳng phải [chúng tôi đã bước đi] theo cùng những dấu chân sao?
vi.B: Chẳng phải chúng tôi đã đi theo cùng những dấu chân sao?
vi.R: Chúng tôi làm mọi việc theo cùng một cách, phải không?

ko.L: 같은 발자취로 [행하지] 않았습니까?
ko.B: 우리가 같은 발자취를 따라 걷지 않았습니까?
ko.R: 우리는 같은 방식으로 일했습니다. 그렇지 않습니까?

decisions.choice: the same footsteps: following the same path
decisions.reason: ἴχνεσιν are footprints. To walk in the same footsteps is to follow the same path, here the same honest conduct.

decisions.choice: Did we not tread
decisions.reason: Balanced supplies the verb from the question before.

decisions.choice: "[chúng tôi đã bước đi]"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese needs a verb for the question; Literal brackets it, Balanced supplies it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "같은 발자취" (L, B); "같은 방식" (R)

source.text: Πάλαι δοκεῖτε ὅτι ὑμῖν ἀπολογούμεθα;

records.literal_gloss: All along you think that to you we are making a defense?

en.L: All along you have been thinking that we are making our defense to you?
en.B: Have you supposed this whole time that we are pleading our case before you?
en.R: Do you think that all this time we have been trying to prove our innocence to you?

fr.L: Depuis longtemps vous pensez que nous nous défendons devant vous ?
fr.B: Pensez-vous depuis tout ce temps que nous plaidons notre cause devant vous ?
fr.R: Croyez-vous que, depuis le début, nous essayons de vous prouver que nous sommes innocents ?

es.L: ¿Desde hace tiempo {{plural_you:piensan|pensáis}} que nos estamos defendiendo ante {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.B: ¿{{plural_you:Han|Habéis}} pensado todo este tiempo que estamos defendiendo nuestra causa ante {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.R: ¿{{plural_you:Creen|Creéis}} que todo este tiempo hemos estado tratando de {{plural_you:demostrarles|demostraros}} que somos inocentes?

sw.L: Tangu zamani mnadhani kwamba tunajitetea kwenu?
sw.B: Je, mmekuwa mkidhani wakati huu wote kwamba tunajitetea mbele yenu?
sw.R: Je, mnadhani kwamba muda huu wote tumekuwa tukijaribu kuwathibitishia kwamba hatuna hatia?

vi.L: Từ nãy đến giờ anh chị em vẫn nghĩ rằng chúng tôi đang tự bào chữa với anh chị em sao?
vi.B: Có phải suốt thời gian qua anh chị em cho rằng chúng tôi đang biện hộ cho mình trước mặt anh chị em không?
vi.R: Anh chị em có nghĩ rằng suốt thời gian qua chúng tôi đang cố chứng minh mình vô tội với anh chị em không?

ko.L: 여러분은 우리가 여러분에게 변명하고 있다고 줄곧 생각해 왔습니까?
ko.B: 여러분은 이제까지 우리가 여러분 앞에서 우리 자신을 변호하고 있다고 생각했습니까?
ko.R: 여러분은 그동안 우리가 여러분에게 우리가 잘못이 없다는 것을 증명하려고 애써 왔다고 생각합니까?

decisions.choice: making a defense: pleading one's case before judges
decisions.reason: ἀπολογούμεθα is the word for a defense in court. Paul does not accept the Corinthians as his judges; the next sentence names his real judge.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "all along"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts read a similar word meaning "again" instead of Πάλαι ("for a long time, all along"), the reading of the King James Version. The SBLGNT text is followed. Reviewers must check the manuscript evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: a question, as in the SBLGNT
alternatives: a statement: you have been thinking all along that we are defending ourselves
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT prints a question mark. As a statement the sentence would say what they think and then correct it; as a question it challenges them. The meaning is close either way.

decisions.choice: we: Paul himself, perhaps with his coworkers
decisions.reason: As through much of the letter (see 1:8), "we" is mostly Paul himself.

decisions.choice: "tự bào chữa" (L); "biện hộ cho mình" (B); "cố chứng minh mình vô tội" (R) for apologeomai
decisions.reason: Pleading one's case before judges (m1).

decisions.choice: "변명하다" (L); "변호하다" (B); "잘못이 없다는 것을 증명하다" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as a defense in court; Paul does not accept the Corinthians as his judges.

source.text: κατέναντι θεοῦ ἐν Χριστῷ λαλοῦμεν.

records.literal_gloss: Before God in Christ we speak.

en.L: Before God in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} we speak.
en.B: We are speaking in the sight of God, as those who are in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: God is watching as we speak, and we speak as people who belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

fr.L: Devant Dieu, {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, nous parlons.
fr.B: C’est devant Dieu que nous parlons, comme des gens qui sont {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}.
fr.R: Dieu nous regarde quand nous parlons, et nous parlons comme des gens qui appartiennent au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

es.L: Delante de Dios hablamos en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.B: Hablamos delante de Dios, como quienes están en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.R: Dios nos está mirando mientras hablamos, y hablamos como personas que pertenecen {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}.

sw.L: Mbele za Mungu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} tunanena.
sw.B: Tunasema mbele za Mungu, kama watu walio katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Mungu anatutazama tunaposema, nasi tunasema kama watu walio wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

vi.L: Chúng tôi nói trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời, trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Chúng tôi đang nói trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời, như những người ở trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đang nhìn khi chúng tôi nói, và chúng tôi nói như những người thuộc về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.

ko.L: 우리는 하나님 앞에서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 말합니다.
ko.B: 우리는 하나님께서 보시는 앞에서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에 있는 사람으로서 말하고 있습니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 우리가 말하는 것을 지켜보고 계시고, 우리는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 속한 사람으로서 말합니다.

decisions.choice: before God, in Christ: God is the judge Paul answers to
decisions.reason: The same words appear in 2:17. Paul speaks answerable to God and as one united with Christ, not as a defendant before the Corinthians.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} (L, B); au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} (R)
decisions.reason: French cannot say "en Messie", so the span for "in Christ" covers the preposition, as in Colossians; elsewhere the article stays outside the span ("au Christ" / "au Messie").

decisions.choice: "trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời" (L, B); "Đức Chúa Trời đang nhìn" (R)
decisions.reason: God is the judge Paul answers to (m1); as in 2:17.

decisions.choice: "하나님 앞에서 ... 안에서" as at 2:17
decisions.reason: The wording of 2:17.

source.text: τὰ δὲ πάντα, ἀγαπητοί, ὑπὲρ τῆς ὑμῶν οἰκοδομῆς, φοβοῦμαι γὰρ μή πως ἐλθὼν οὐχ οἵους θέλω εὕρω ὑμᾶς, κἀγὼ εὑρεθῶ ὑμῖν οἷον οὐ θέλετε, μή πως ἔρις, ζῆλος, θυμοί, ἐριθεῖαι, καταλαλιαί, ψιθυρισμοί, φυσιώσεις, ἀκαταστασίαι·

records.literal_gloss: The but all things, beloved, [are] for the of you building up. \v 20 I fear for lest perhaps having come not such as I want I may find you, and I may be found by you such as not you want; lest perhaps strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambitions, slanders, whisperings, puffings up, disorders;

en.L: And all things, beloved, [are] for your building up. \v 20 For I fear that perhaps, having come, I may find you not such as I want, and I may be found by you such as you do not want; that perhaps [there may be] strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambitions, slanders, whisperings, puffings up, disorders.
en.B: Everything we do, dear friends, is to build you up. \v 20 For I fear that I may come and find you other than I wish, and that you may find me other than you wish. I fear there may be quarreling, jealousy, outbursts of anger, rivalry, slander, whispering behind backs, people puffed up with pride, and disorder.
en.R: Everything we do, dear friends, is to build you up. \v 20 I worry that when I arrive, I will find you living in ways I do not like, and you will find me acting in ways you will not like. I am afraid that you will be quarreling, jealous, and losing your tempers. I am afraid some of you will be trying to get ahead of others, saying bad things about each other, gossiping, being proud, and causing disorder.

fr.L: Et tout cela, bien-aimés, [est] pour votre édification. \v 20 Car je crains que peut-être, en venant, je ne vous trouve pas tels que je [le] veux, et que je sois trouvé par vous tel que vous ne [le] voulez pas ; que peut-être [il n’y ait] querelle, jalousie, colères, ambitions égoïstes, médisances, chuchotements, enflures [d’orgueil], désordres.
fr.B: Tout ce que nous faisons, chers amis, c’est pour vous édifier. \v 20 Car je crains, en venant, de vous trouver autres que je ne le souhaite, et que vous me trouviez autre que vous ne le souhaitez. Je crains qu’il n’y ait des querelles, de la jalousie, des accès de colère, des rivalités, des médisances, des commérages, des gens enflés d’orgueil et du désordre.
fr.R: Tout ce que nous faisons, chers amis, c’est pour vous aider à grandir. \v 20 J’ai peur, quand j’arriverai, de vous trouver en train de vivre d’une manière qui ne me plaît pas, et que vous me trouviez en train d’agir d’une manière qui ne vous plaira pas. J’ai peur que vous soyez en train de vous disputer, d’être jaloux et de vous mettre en colère. J’ai peur que certains cherchent à passer devant les autres, disent du mal les uns des autres, colportent des ragots, soient pleins d’orgueil et mettent le désordre.

es.L: Y todo, amados, [es] para {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} edificación. \v 20 Porque temo que tal vez, al llegar, no {{plural_you:los|os}} encuentre como quiero, y yo sea hallado por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} como no {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}}; que tal vez [haya] contienda, celos, arrebatos de ira, ambiciones egoístas, maledicencias, chismes, envanecimientos, desórdenes.
es.B: Todo lo que hacemos, queridos amigos, es para {{plural_you:edificarlos|edificaros}}. \v 20 Porque temo que, cuando llegue, no {{plural_you:los|os}} encuentre como quisiera, y que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} me {{plural_you:encuentren|encontréis}} a mí como no {{plural_you:quisieran|quisierais}}. Temo que haya peleas, celos, arrebatos de ira, rivalidades, maledicencias, chismes, gente envanecida y desorden.
es.R: Todo lo que hacemos, queridos amigos, es para {{plural_you:fortalecerlos|fortaleceros}}. \v 20 Me preocupa que, cuando llegue, {{plural_you:los|os}} encuentre viviendo de una manera que no me gusta, y que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} me {{plural_you:encuentren|encontréis}} actuando de una manera que no {{plural_you:les|os}} va a gustar. Tengo miedo de que {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} peleando, de que {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} celos y de que {{plural_you:pierdan|perdáis}} los estribos. Tengo miedo de que algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} estén tratando de quedar por encima de los demás, hablando mal unos de otros, chismeando, siendo orgullosos y causando desorden.

sw.L: Na mambo yote, wapendwa, [ni] kwa ajili ya kujengwa kwenu. \v 20 Kwa maana ninaogopa kwamba labda, nikija, nisiwakute kama ninavyotaka, nami nikaonekana kwenu kama msivyotaka; kwamba labda [kuna] mabishano, wivu, milipuko ya hasira, ubinafsi, masingizio, manong'onezo, majivuno, machafuko.
sw.B: Kila tunachofanya, wapendwa, ni kwa ajili ya kuwajenga. \v 20 Kwa maana ninaogopa kwamba nikija nitawakuta mkiwa tofauti na ninavyotaka, nanyi mtanikuta tofauti na mnavyotaka. Ninaogopa kwamba kunaweza kuwa na magomvi, wivu, milipuko ya hasira, kujitafutia makuu, masingizio, kusengenyana, watu waliojaa majivuno, na machafuko.
sw.R: Kila tunachofanya, wapendwa, ni kwa ajili ya kuwajenga. \v 20 Nina wasiwasi kwamba nitakapofika nitawakuta mkiishi kwa namna nisiyoipenda, nanyi mtanikuta nikitenda kwa namna msiyoipenda. Ninaogopa kwamba mtakuwa mkigombana, mkioneana wivu, na mkikasirika upesi. Ninaogopa kwamba baadhi yenu mtakuwa mkijaribu kujiweka mbele ya wengine, mkisemana vibaya, mkisengenyana, mkiwa na kiburi, na mkisababisha machafuko.

vi.L: Và mọi điều, thưa những người yêu dấu, đều vì sự gây dựng anh chị em. \v 20 Vì tôi sợ rằng có lẽ khi đến, tôi sẽ thấy anh chị em không như tôi muốn, và anh chị em sẽ thấy tôi không như anh chị em muốn; [sợ rằng] có lẽ [sẽ có] sự tranh cãi, sự ghen tị, những cơn nóng giận, những sự ganh đua ích kỷ, những lời vu khống, những lời nói thầm, những sự kiêu căng, những sự hỗn loạn.
vi.B: Thưa anh chị em yêu dấu, mọi điều chúng tôi làm đều là để gây dựng anh chị em. \v 20 Vì tôi sợ rằng khi tôi đến, tôi sẽ thấy anh chị em không như tôi mong muốn, và anh chị em sẽ thấy tôi không như anh chị em mong muốn. Tôi sợ rằng sẽ có tranh cãi, ghen tị, những cơn giận dữ, ganh đua ích kỷ, vu khống, nói xấu sau lưng, kiêu căng và hỗn loạn.
vi.R: Anh chị em thân mến, mọi điều chúng tôi làm là để gây dựng anh chị em. \v 20 Tôi lo rằng khi tôi đến, tôi sẽ thấy anh chị em sống theo cách tôi không vừa ý, và anh chị em sẽ thấy tôi hành động theo cách anh chị em không vừa ý. Tôi sợ rằng anh chị em sẽ đang cãi nhau, ghen tức và nổi nóng với nhau. Tôi sợ rằng một số người trong anh chị em sẽ đang tìm cách hơn người khác, nói xấu nhau, ngồi lê đôi mách, kiêu ngạo và gây rối loạn.

ko.L: 사랑하는 여러분, 모든 것은 여러분의 덕을 세우기 위한 것입니다. \v 20 내가 가서 여러분이 내가 바라는 모습이 아닌 것을 보게 되고, 나도 여러분이 바라지 않는 모습으로 여러분에게 보이게 되지 않을까 두렵습니다. 혹시 다툼과 시기와 분노와 경쟁심과 비방과 수군거림과 우쭐함과 무질서가 [있지 않을까 두렵습니다].
ko.B: 사랑하는 여러분, 우리가 하는 모든 일은 여러분을 세우기 위한 것입니다. \v 20 내가 가서 여러분이 내가 바라는 모습이 아닌 것을 보게 되고, 여러분도 내가 여러분이 바라지 않는 모습인 것을 보게 되지 않을까 두렵습니다. 나는 다툼과 시기와 분노의 폭발과 이기적인 경쟁과 비방과 뒷말과 교만으로 우쭐함과 무질서가 있지 않을까 두렵습니다.
ko.R: 사랑하는 여러분, 우리가 하는 모든 일은 여러분을 세우기 위한 것입니다. \v 20 내가 가서 여러분이 내가 좋아하지 않는 방식으로 사는 것을 보게 되고, 여러분도 내가 여러분이 좋아하지 않을 방식으로 행동하는 것을 보게 되지 않을까 걱정입니다. 나는 여러분이 서로 싸우고, 시기하고, 화를 터뜨리지 않을까 두렵습니다. 나는 여러분 가운데 어떤 사람들이 남보다 앞서려 하고, 서로 나쁜 말을 하고, 뒷말을 하고, 교만하게 굴고, 질서를 어지럽히지 않을까 두렵습니다.

decisions.choice: all for your building up: everything Paul says and does aims at their growth
decisions.reason: οἰκοδομῆς is building up, the purpose for which the Lord gave Paul his authority (10:8; 13:10). Even the boasting and the defense are for the Corinthians' good. ἀγαπητοί ("beloved") shows his affection even as he warns.

decisions.choice: you may find me as you do not wish: Paul may have to act with severity
decisions.reason: If he finds them unchanged, he will come with discipline, not gentleness (1 Corinthians 4:21; 2 Corinthians 13:2, 10). That is the side of him they do not want to see.

decisions.choice: the list: sins that tear a church apart
alternatives: sins of the pagan world only
decisions.reason: ἔρις ζῆλος ("strife, jealousy") are the words of 1 Corinthians 3:3, where they show the divisions. θυμοί are outbursts of anger. ἐριθεῖαι is selfish ambition and rivalry (Philippians 2:3). καταλαλιαί is speaking against others and ψιθυρισμοί whispered gossip. φυσιώσεις is being "puffed up", the Corinthians' pride (1 Corinthians 4:6, 18; 8:1). ἀκαταστασίαι here is disorder in the church, as in 1 Corinthians 14:33, not riots in the streets as in 6:5.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "strife, jealousy" in the singular
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts have these first two words in the plural, like the rest of the list. The meaning is the same. The SBLGNT text is followed. Reviewers must check the manuscript evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: we: Paul himself
decisions.reason: The "we" of verse 19 is Paul (with his coworkers), and he goes on in the first person singular in verse 20.

decisions.choice: strife, jealousy, selfish ambitions, puffings up (L); quarreling, jealousy, rivalry, puffed up with pride (B); quarreling, jealous, trying to get ahead, proud (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as in 1 Corinthians 3:3 and Philippians 2:3, and "puffed up" (Readable "proud") as in 1 Corinthians 4 and 8.

decisions.choice: I fear there may be (B); I am afraid that ... (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable repeat the verb of fearing so that the list can stand as a sentence.

decisions.choice: beloved (L); dear friends (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 7:1.

decisions.choice: ambitions égoïstes (L), rivalités (B); enflures [d’orgueil] (L), gens enflés d’orgueil (B), pleins d’orgueil (R)
decisions.reason: The list uses the words of Galatians 5:20 and of "puffed up" in 1 Corinthians 4-5 ("enflés d’orgueil"). French cannot say "enflures" alone for pride, so the image is completed with "d’orgueil", bracketed at Literal.

decisions.choice: amados (L); queridos amigos (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 7:1: Literal keeps "amados", and Balanced and Readable use the warm everyday address "queridos amigos", as the English does.

decisions.choice: envanecimientos (L); gente envanecida (B)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Corinthians 4:6 and 4:18, the puffed-up word is "envanecer" at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "orgullosos", as the English Readable says "proud".

decisions.choice: mabishano, wivu, milipuko ya hasira, ubinafsi (L); magomvi, kujitafutia makuu (B)
decisions.reason: The first words of the list are the same as in Galatians 5:20, so Swahili uses the words chosen there at each level. "Majivuno" (conceit) renders "puffed up", as the meaning is pride and not the boasting of chapters 10-12. "Wapendwa" as in 7:1.

decisions.choice: "thưa những người yêu dấu" (L); "Thưa anh chị em yêu dấu" (B); "Anh chị em thân mến" (R) for agapetoi
decisions.reason: As in 7:1 and 1 Corinthians 10:14.

decisions.choice: the vice list in the words of the Vietnamese Galatians 5:20 where they overlap: "sự tranh cãi, sự ghen tị, những cơn nóng giận, những sự ganh đua ích kỷ" (L); "tranh cãi, ghen tị, những cơn giận dữ, ganh đua ích kỷ" (B); "cãi nhau, ghen tức, nổi nóng, tìm cách hơn người khác" (R)
decisions.reason: Sins that tear a church apart (m3); the same Greek words as Galatians 5:20, so the same Vietnamese. "Kiêu căng" (L, B) and "kiêu ngạo" (R) for physiosis follow 1 Corinthians 4-8.

decisions.choice: "sự gây dựng" for oikodome
decisions.reason: Everything aims at their growth (m1); the book's word (10:8; 13:10).

decisions.choice: "다툼, 시기, 분노, 경쟁심, 비방, 수군거림, 우쭐함, 무질서" (L); plainer phrases at Basic and Readable
decisions.reason: The words of Galatians 5:20 and Romans 1:29-30, and "우쭐하다" as in 1 Corinthians 4-5; "무질서" for the disorder of 1 Corinthians 14:33.

decisions.choice: "사랑하는 여러분" at every level
decisions.reason: As at 7:1.

decisions.choice: "덕을 세우다" (L); "세우다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The building up of 10:8 and 1 Corinthians 14.

source.text: μὴ πάλιν ἐλθόντος μου ταπεινώσῃ με ὁ θεός μου πρὸς ὑμᾶς, καὶ πενθήσω πολλοὺς τῶν προημαρτηκότων καὶ μὴ μετανοησάντων ἐπὶ τῇ ἀκαθαρσίᾳ καὶ πορνείᾳ καὶ ἀσελγείᾳ ᾗ ἔπραξαν.

records.literal_gloss: Lest again having come me may humble me the God of me before you, and I may mourn many of those having sinned before and not having repented of the impurity and sexual immorality and sensuality which they practiced.

en.L: [I fear] that again, when I come, my God may humble me before you, and I may mourn over many of those who have sinned before and have not repented of the impurity and sexual immorality and sensuality that they practiced.
en.B: I fear that when I come, my God may again bring me low in front of you, and that I may have to mourn over many who sinned in the past and still have not repented of what they did: impurity, sexual immorality and indecency.
en.R: I am afraid that on my visit my God will make me feel low and ashamed in front of you again. I am afraid I will cry over many people who sinned before and have not turned away from what was wrong. They have done impure things, sexual sins and shameless things.

fr.L: [Je crains] que de nouveau, à ma venue, mon Dieu ne m’humilie devant vous, et que je n’aie à pleurer sur beaucoup de ceux qui ont péché auparavant et ne se sont pas repentis de l’impureté, de l’immoralité sexuelle et de la débauche qu’ils ont pratiquées.
fr.B: Je crains qu’à ma venue, mon Dieu ne m’humilie de nouveau devant vous, et que je doive pleurer sur beaucoup de ceux qui ont péché dans le passé et ne se sont toujours pas repentis de ce qu’ils ont fait : l’impureté, l’immoralité sexuelle et l’indécence.
fr.R: J’ai peur que, pendant ma visite, mon Dieu me fasse encore me sentir humilié et honteux devant vous. J’ai peur de pleurer sur beaucoup de gens qui ont péché autrefois et ne se sont pas détournés du mal qu’ils ont fait. Ils ont commis des actes impurs, des péchés sexuels et des choses sans honte.

es.L: [Temo] que, al volver yo, mi Dios me humille otra vez ante {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y tenga que llorar por muchos de los que antes han pecado y no se han arrepentido de la impureza, la inmoralidad sexual y el libertinaje que practicaron.
es.B: Temo que, cuando llegue, mi Dios vuelva a humillarme delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y que tenga que llorar por muchos que pecaron en el pasado y todavía no se han arrepentido de lo que hicieron: impureza, inmoralidad sexual e indecencia.
es.R: Tengo miedo de que, en mi visita, mi Dios me haga sentir otra vez humillado y avergonzado delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Tengo miedo de llorar por muchas personas que pecaron antes y no se han apartado de lo que estaba mal. Han hecho cosas impuras, han cometido pecados sexuales y cosas vergonzosas.

sw.L: [Ninaogopa] kwamba tena, nitakapokuja, Mungu wangu atanidhili mbele yenu, nami nikawaombolezea wengi wa wale waliotenda dhambi hapo kwanza na hawakutubu juu ya unajisi na zinaa na ukosefu wa haya waliyoyatenda.
sw.B: Ninaogopa kwamba nitakapokuja, Mungu wangu atanishusha tena mbele yenu, nami nitalazimika kuwaombolezea wengi waliotenda dhambi zamani na bado hawajatubu kwa yale waliyotenda: unajisi, zinaa na tabia isiyo na haya.
sw.R: Ninaogopa kwamba nitakapowatembelea, Mungu wangu atanifanya nijisikie mnyonge na mwenye aibu mbele yenu tena. Ninaogopa kwamba nitawalilia watu wengi waliotenda dhambi zamani na hawajageuka na kuacha yale yaliyokuwa mabaya. Wametenda mambo machafu, dhambi za ngono na mambo ya aibu.

vi.L: [Tôi sợ] rằng khi tôi đến, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi sẽ lại hạ tôi xuống trước mặt anh chị em, và tôi phải than khóc vì nhiều người trong những người đã phạm tội trước đây mà chưa ăn năn về sự ô uế, sự tà dâm và sự phóng đãng mà họ đã làm.
vi.B: Tôi sợ rằng khi tôi đến, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi sẽ lại hạ tôi xuống trước mặt anh chị em, và tôi phải than khóc vì nhiều người đã phạm tội trước đây mà vẫn chưa ăn năn về những điều họ đã làm: ô uế, tà dâm và phóng đãng.
vi.R: Tôi sợ rằng trong chuyến thăm này, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi sẽ lại khiến tôi phải thấy mình thấp hèn và xấu hổ trước mặt anh chị em. Tôi sợ rằng tôi sẽ phải khóc vì nhiều người đã phạm tội trước đây mà chưa từ bỏ những điều sai trái. Họ đã sống ô uế, phạm tội tình dục và sống trơ trẽn không biết xấu hổ.

ko.L: 내가 다시 갈 때 나의 하나님께서 여러분 앞에서 나를 낮추시고, 내가 전에 죄를 짓고 그들이 행한 더러움과 음행과 방탕을 회개하지 않은 많은 사람 때문에 슬피 울게 되지 않을까 [두렵습니다].
ko.B: 내가 갈 때 나의 하나님께서 여러분 앞에서 나를 다시 낮추시지 않을까 두렵습니다. 그리고 전에 죄를 짓고도 그들이 저지른 일, 곧 더러움과 음행과 방탕을 아직도 회개하지 않은 많은 사람 때문에 내가 슬피 울어야 하지 않을까 두렵습니다.
ko.R: 내가 여러분을 찾아갈 때 나의 하나님께서 여러분 앞에서 나를 다시 낮아지고 부끄럽게 하시지 않을까 두렵습니다. 그리고 전에 죄를 짓고도 잘못된 길에서 돌아서지 않은 많은 사람 때문에 내가 울게 되지 않을까 두렵습니다. 그들은 더러운 일과 성적인 죄와 부끄러움을 모르는 일을 저질렀습니다.

decisions.choice: the fear goes on from verse 20
alternatives: a new sentence with no link
decisions.reason: μὴ repeats the "lest" of verse 20, so this is a further thing Paul fears.

decisions.choice: "again" goes with being humbled: Paul fears a second humbling visit
decisions.reason: πάλιν stands between the start of the sentence and "when I come". It can go with the coming ("when I come again") or with the humbling ("may humble me again"). Since Paul's last visit was a painful one (2:1), many read it as a fear of being humbled again.

decisions.choice: humble: bring low, put to shame
decisions.reason: ταπεινώσῃ here is to bring someone low. A father is shamed by his children's conduct; Paul would be humiliated before them if his converts were still living in sin. He says God may allow this.

decisions.choice: mourn over those who sinned and did not repent
decisions.reason: πενθήσω is to mourn, as for the dead (compare 1 Corinthians 5:2). προημαρτηκότων is perfect: they sinned before, perhaps before the painful visit, and the sin continues. They have not repented. Paul's mourning may include the discipline he will have to carry out (13:2).

decisions.choice: impurity, sexual immorality, sensuality
decisions.reason: ἀκαθαρσίᾳ is moral impurity, πορνείᾳ sexual immorality of every kind (1 Corinthians 5:1; 6:18), and ἀσελγείᾳ unrestrained, shameless indecency. The same words appear together in Galatians 5:19.

decisions.choice: impurity, sexual immorality, sensuality (L); impurity, sexual immorality, indecency (B); impure things, sexual sins, shameless things (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as in Colossians 3:5 and Ephesians 4:19, where these terms appear.

decisions.choice: turned away from what was wrong
decisions.reason: Readable explains repentance in plain words, as the book-wide choice for this word family does.

decisions.choice: [I fear]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the verb of fearing from verse 20 (m1).

decisions.choice: l’impureté, l’immoralité sexuelle, la débauche (L); ... l’indécence (B); des actes impurs, des péchés sexuels, des choses sans honte (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as Galatians 5:19 and Colossians 3:5 in French. "Fornication" is church language and too narrow; "luxure" names a desire rather than conduct.

decisions.choice: unajisi, zinaa, ukosefu wa haya (L); tabia isiyo na haya (B); mambo machafu, dhambi za ngono, mambo ya aibu (R)
decisions.reason: The same three words as at the head of the list in Galatians 5:19, at each level. Readable says "hawajageuka na kuacha yale yaliyokuwa mabaya" for repenting, as in 7:9.

decisions.choice: "sự ô uế, sự tà dâm và sự phóng đãng" (L); "ô uế, tà dâm và phóng đãng" (B); "sống ô uế, phạm tội tình dục và sống trơ trẽn không biết xấu hổ" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Galatians 5:19 at each level, for the same three Greek words (m5); "tội tình dục" (R) is the book's Readable word for porneia.

decisions.choice: "lại" with the humbling (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: "Again" goes with being humbled: a second humbling visit (m2, uncertain). Vietnamese "lại" sits next to the verb it belongs to.

decisions.choice: "ăn năn" (L, B); "từ bỏ những điều sai trái" (R) for metanoeo
decisions.reason: The book's word for repentance (7:9-10).

decisions.choice: "더러움, 음행, 방탕" (L, B); "더러운 일, 성적인 죄, 부끄러움을 모르는 일" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Galatians 5:19 and the project's "음행" (L, B), "성적인 죄" (R).

decisions.choice: "회개하다" (L, B); "잘못된 길에서 돌아서다" (R)
"다시" with "갈 때" (L); with "낮추시다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "again" with being humbled; Literal keeps the Greek's order, and Basic and Readable make the reading plain.
